verification.note: Read from the product having one load, which its group 1 controls, as on other one-load products.

steps.text: Plug the lamp or device you want to control (the load) into the outlet on the bottom of the module.
Plug the module into an unswitched wall outlet.
steps.expect: The status LED and the load turn on.

steps.text: If the load doesn't turn on, turn it on with its own switch.

notes: The pass-through outlet on the front can be used as an ordinary uncontrolled outlet, but don't plug another home automation product into it.
Don't plug the module into a switched outlet, a filtered power strip or an AC line filter, and don't stack modules by plugging them into one another.
Turn the lamp's own switch on, and any built-in dimmer to full. After installation the lamp's switch controls the load only if load sensing is enabled (it is by default).

steps.text: With the controller in linking mode, press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: Status LED flashes twice, then turns on solid; the load flashes twice.

notes: The documents describe linking the module only as a responder. Put the controller in linking mode first; for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds or the SET button for 3 seconds. Setup modes time out after 4 minutes.
Holding the SET button for 3 seconds on its own puts the module in linking mode: the status LED blinks and the load flashes once. Linking mode times out after 4 minutes of inactivity.

steps.text: With the controller in unlinking mode, press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds.
steps.expect: Status LED flashes twice, then turns on solid; the load flashes twice.

notes: Put the controller in unlinking mode first; for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds twice or the SET button for 3 seconds twice.

steps.text: If a controller controls the module, unlink it from the controller first.
While holding down the SET button, plug the module back in. Don't let go of the SET button.
Keep holding the SET button for 3 seconds, then release it.
steps.expect: Status LED flashes once and turns off; after a few seconds the status LED and the load turn on.

steps.text: Unlink the module from every controller it is linked to.

notes: Otherwise the controllers keep retrying commands, slowing down the system.
